retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic urban portrait featuring a central figure in an alleyway with dramatic side-lighting and a mix of script and sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man walking through a dimly lit brick alleyway at night, characterized by a strong key light from the side creating a long shadow on a textured brick wall, with secondary figures in the background and top-aligned text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center casting a large shadow to the right
Receding perspective of the alleyway leading to an archway on the left
Text elements anchored to the top-left corner
Warm brick textures contrasting with cool, dark shadows
coreInvariants: Dramatic side-lighting creating a high-contrast shadow on the brick wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is full-body, positioned in the right third of the frame, scaled to occupy most of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary subject's face and the large shadow on the brick wall.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down to the subject, then follows the shadow and the receding alleyway into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space in the upper-middle and left background to provide depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (browns and tans) from the brickwork.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in the shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Creamy white for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between lit surfaces and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or vibrant primary colors

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a fluid, brush-like script with connected lowercase letters
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'D' and 'H' in the script are oversized and expressive
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive script paired with rigid, spaced-out geometric sans-serif for a balanced 80s look.

preserve: The contrast between script and wide sans-serif

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the brush-script energy of the primary text
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photograph of a man in dark clothing walking through a brick alleyway at night. Use a strong side light to cast a long, distinct shadow on the brick wall to his right. Include a distant archway and secondary figures in the background to create depth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large, cream-colored brush script in the top-left corner. Directly below it, add the album title in a small, all-caps, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the shadow on the brick wall prominent?
Is the script text expressive and brush-like?
Is the subtitle text widely tracked and all-caps?
Is the lighting dramatic and directional?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific name 'Dan Hartman'
Avoid using the specific title 'I Can Dream About You'

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subject and background through lighting
avoid: Modern, minimalist sans-serif fonts without tracking

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is aligned to the top-left.
Ensure the shadow on the wall is a key compositional element.
Confirm the script and sans-serif pairing is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Side Lighting + Brick Texture + Script/Sans-Serif Typography Pairing
